review.notes: accepted. Revision 2 resolves both defects of the first package review: the supplier contracts now list only what the suppliers state, with 21 new sourced targets (0.24-0.28, 1.4-1.5, 2.14, 3.11-3.12, 5.13, 6.1, 6.18, 6.25, 6.28, 6.31, 6.36-6.37, 7.6, 7.15) and explicit narrowings (Hodge-type data in Layers 7-8, Siegel p>=3 in 0.17 and 5.5-5.7, finite K/Q_p in Layer 1, the strict BHW range for p>=3); Layer 6 is rebuilt on PrismaticCohomology section 8.60 and 7.15 specializes to CohomologyComparisons section 6.1. Checked: the front matter, every new target and the 20 rewritten ones, mathematically (table in the report); 14 sources downloaded with matching SHA-256, 378 label/page pairs by script and every new-target locator read; 112 contract items and 36 Needs citations against the suppliers' own packages or packets; duplication of the new targets against lower-tier packages, unpackaged supplier packets, current TauCetiRoadmap main and current Tau Ceti a91d3aaf. Corrected in place: two wrong Checks (1.4 integral cokernel called 'of length 1/(p-1)'; 4.6 Check on the excluded endpoint eps = 1/(2p), and HALO's range is 3.10 not 3.9) and two ambiguous ones (0.25, 3.12); 0.24's p^k-shift needs a p-adic V; 3.11(4) needs X reduced; 7.29 attributed G^c = G to neat level; section numbers of ZIE Definition 3.4 and Theorems 3.14-3.15 and PS16 Proposition 1.5 and Corollaire 1.7; SCH13 added to the References; supplier citations made to match the suppliers (ModularCurves 0G is the Hopf-algebra Grassmannian; ReductiveGroups Layers 3/7 wording and G/P_mu from ShimuraData D3; A3.7 polarized Weil pairings; AdicSpacesPartII dimension is R1.40; AutomorphicBundles B3.7/B3.general.2 nilpotent residues; 35 ordinal ShimuraCompactifications labels replaced by node names; ClassicalAdicEtaleCohomology sections 1.3, 11.1, 11.2; E2.2, C5.8, C7.9); 6.12 now states composition and base change of Kummer etale maps (DLLZ-adic Proposition 4.1.14), which section 8.60 uses only in a proof; 0.26 now cites DerivedDeRhamCohomology sections 0.1, 0.5, 0.6 and 0.9 for the cotangent complex and says that FiniteFlat R07.1.11 and R07.6.6 use the same co-Lie complex; 6.28 states how it differs from DiamondEtaleCohomology C0.17/C0.23 (quasi-pro-etale site of diamonds); two process phrases. Duplication sweep: no new target restates a lower-tier, TauCetiRoadmap or current Tau Ceti statement. Lean: lean-check exits 0 with four sorry warnings only (theorems at lines 43, 111, 139, 154), 227 lines, Mathlib only; a run_cmd audit shows only those four theorems depend on sorryAx; check_sorry_data and intake check-files report no problems. For the maintainer: PrismaticCohomology's revision must keep section 8.60; the packets lag the package; consumers of general Shimura data and Hilbert-Siegel models are outside the narrowed scope.
